claims.claim: Pydantic v2 validation with effective extra="forbid" rejects input fields not declared by the model.
Pydantic 2.13.5 model_copy(update=...) applies updates without validating the supplied values.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction per database, and BEGIN IMMEDIATE can fail with SQLITE_BUSY when another connection already has an active write transaction.
Executing RAISE(ABORT, message) in a SQLite trigger terminates the current query and returns SQLITE_CONSTRAINT with the supplied message.
Python 3.12 hashlib provides sha256, and a hash object's hexdigest method returns its digest as hexadecimal text.
RFC 8785 sorts JSON object property names using unsigned UTF-16 code units and encodes the resulting canonical serialization in UTF-8.
